Page 79 Cont.
Oct. 8th Mrs. Anna George - 50 - inward cancer quite helpless & hopeless Enrolled. Oct 16 sitting up ... Deo Gr.
Page 80
Oct. 8 Mrs. M. S. Holscher - family very urgent - finantial ... Mrs. Marg. Fallon - 26 - Thanksgiving was to have appentix oper- ation last Friday. Husband called up .... nothing wrong next day. Comes To-day O.K. enrolles perpetually
11 Mrs. Fr. Schoener - 39 - very badly cut arm - 3 blood vessels, etc severed. ...
Frances Lumetta - 40 - inward cancer - operation two weeks ago .... Coming along poorly - Enrolled To-day 50c
Dorothy Ring - 37 - Eva Andres - 63 - losing sight
Page 81
Oct. 12 Irene Rickwalt - 29 - nerveous Break- has one little girl 6.
12 Henry Kruger - 50 - non Cath. Abcesses pertenitis. Enrolled % phone
12 Lester Francis Zablocki - 5 - Shot accidently - Father almost John J. Jighe (St. Mary's Parish Redford) yellow Jandes. . . Plans to go to Mayo Brs. by air-plain ... Enrolled To-day 50c ... brother promising .... for him
14 DEO GRATIAS .!!! Louis C. Laboe - 46 - of 308 Michigan Ave., Monroe, Mich. came here Sept. 8th last - carried (almost) in by four men with broken back and scull healing from fracture. (See note Sept. 8) Comes To-day in perfect condition. He tells me he left monastery that day without any assistance. Has been working since Sept. 21.
Page 82
Oct. 14th Mrs. Sarah J. Ellwood - 79 last Xmas. Kidney and liver trouble.
